items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 05 May 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, with shallow area of low pressure near Scotland, as weak frontal zones affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

North or northwest, soon veering east, 3 to 5, veering south or southeast 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the northwest of the area until later.


##Weather##

Fair to start, then isolated rain soon, becoming confined to the west later.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southeast 2 to 4, increasing 5 in the east for a time.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Isolated rain or showers.


##Visibility##

Good.
